text:
leah: Heads-up — StratusSI (systems integrator) just asked if we can pull forward 150 racks for an EU pilot next month. Vendor lead times are slipping; they offered to split manifests but need a temporary hedge from us. Can we move on this?

ravi: Which SKU/vendor and where are the reservations currently coming from? soft vs hard reserve?

leah: SKU = orion-sku-r6. Vendor = NovaRack. They can split into 60/90 but ETA would move up only if we mark some as priority. Current marketplace pool has 300 racks committed across Q2 promos. Proposal in mind: soft-reserve 100 (50 EU-1 / 50 EU-2), mark 60 as priority for the pilot, leave 90 for marketplace but with reallocation window.

ben: Are the 150 part of our committed marketplace inventory or vendor buffer? Need finance ok on credits if we shift.

anna: Product/legal heads up: exposing a "soft_reserve" to partners — any concerns on contract or UI side? Also ops comms / customers will need a heads-up.

orion-bot: NovaRack manifest update: split confirmed. AWB ABC123 -> 60 items ETA 2026-04-12; AWB DEF456 -> 90 items ETA 2026-04-20. Customs docs pending.

ravi: If we accept split, route 60 -> integrator pilot first. Customs hold risk still exists, so we need fallback: either swap to Dedicated capacity (temporary) or fallback to hosted overspill. Product can add a soft_reserve flag to control partner visibility.

leah: Action plan (draft):
1) Submit soft-reserve for 100 racks across EU-1/EU-2 (50/50) via partner portal.
2) Ask NovaRack to mark 60 racks as "priority" for the pilot and provide AWB + customs docs.
3) Notify marketplace ops about possible 6-10 day reallocation window; request temporary credit approval.
4) Finance to confirm crediting policy for early draw.
5) Legal to approve short addendum (temporary SLA shift).

leah: Draft email to NovaRack:
```
Hi Jae,

Thanks for splitting the manifest. To support StratusSI's pilot, can you hold 60 racks as 'priority' and push a soft-reserve for 100 more across EU-1/EU-2? We'll confirm routing and billing by EOD. Please confirm AWB numbers and customs docs timeline.

Thanks,
Leah
```

maria-finance: We can provide up to 30% marketplace credits for early draws if product signs off on the routing policy. Need PO line change + billing update. Rough one-time delta estimate: ~$45k.

sam-legal: Send the addendum draft. Quick Q: does this alter indemnities or data handling? If not, legal can fast-track.

anna: Ops comms — I'll prepare a short note for affected customers and CSMs highlighting reallocation risk and projected timelines.

ben: @maria-finance if finance thumbs up, we should run a downstream impact check on customers who rely on that marketplace pool before reallocation.

ops-runbook: Running impact check now: two customers flagged low-severity (<5% capacity impact). CSMs notified for both, awaiting confirmation.

ravi: I'll prototype the soft_reserve UI toggle and a partner API flag, push a console beta in ~48h. We should gate by an internal policy (max soft-reserve per partner).

leah: Owners: Leah -> ops exec (submit reserve + email NovaRack), Ravi -> product policy & UI, Ben -> finance coordination, Sam -> legal addendum, Anna -> ops comms. I'll follow up with a brief thread update after I submit. :thumbsup:

leah: Submitting soft-reserve request and sending the email to NovaRack now. Will post AWB info when I have it.

ben: Thanks — if AWBs come in, can infra confirm routing feasibility (cross-dock timing)?

orion-bot: NovaRack update received: AWB ABC123 (60) customs docs uploaded; DEF456 (90) docs ETA 2026-04-08.

leah: Great — copying next steps here: confirm finance crediting, legal sign-off, push soft-reserve in portal, and monitor customs. I'll update again within this thread with final numbers and tracking.
